def count_multiples_in_range(lo, hi, k):
    """Count the multiples of a given step value inside a closed interval.

    Picture the integers from lo up to hi laid out on a number line, and
    suppose you need to know how many of them are divisible by k. lo, hi, k
    are ints with 1 <= lo <= hi and k >= 1. A single line of integer
    arithmetic settles the question, no looping required. Return how many
    multiples of k lie in the inclusive range [lo, hi], computed as
    hi // k - (lo - 1) // k exactly. As a sanity check, between 1 and 10 the
    multiples of 3 are 3, 6, and 9, so the count there comes out to 3.

    Examples:
    >>> count_multiples_in_range(1, 10, 3)
    3
    >>> count_multiples_in_range(7, 7, 7)
    1
    """
